source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 19 item and command cover memory-array mapped-address records, but the Procedure also names Manufacturer, Chassis Type/Status, Version, Serial, Asset Tag and Security fields from other structures. The source does not define whether those are intentional companion coverage or copied criteria.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and conflict tracking are complete. Execution is package-gated on field mapping, topology and reboot approval; review can safely proceed to later records.

review_improvement: Preserves all source fields and adds the Type 19 interval, extended-address and Type 16 handle invariants needed to prove a correct memory-array map.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 19 is meaningful only as a set of address intervals tied to physical memory arrays. Even plausible individual start/end values can be wrong if intervals overlap, leave an unapproved hole, reference a nonexistent Type 16 handle or misuse the extended-address sentinel. Those checks require complete records and topology reconciliation; copied chassis labels cannot be satisfied by the same structure and need an explicit owner disposition.
